---
title: "UAV Control"
---

## Overview

A collection of nonlinear controllers for PX4-based unmanned aerial vehicles, including Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI), Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC), Geometric Control, and Sliding Mode Control (SMC).

## Tech Stack

- **Languages:** C++, Python
- **Frameworks:** PX4, ROS 2
- **Methods:** MPPI, NMPC, Geometric Control, SMC
